seoDescription: Your space is already deciding how you live. Book a free fit call, or a one hour Design Jumpstart, with Petrina Salema in Vienna.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Shape the room that holds how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: A redesign of how a home or room operates. Layout and material first, then sourcing, styling, and how family or guests move through the day.
projectOffer.note: I take on a few residences a year. Most take one to three months, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.
projectOffer.finance: Quoted after the fit call, then billed in stages from deposit to final. Full projects are custom-scoped. Jumpstart is €290 if you want a clear first hour. Say on the call if a payment plan would help.

jumpstartOffer.title: Design Jumpstart
jumpstartOffer.body: One hour on the plan. We name the change that would matter most, and you leave with a clear next step.

quote.text: My daughter started calling her room the room from the fairy tale.

secondaryCta.label: Jumpstart
secondaryCta.microcopy: €290 · 60 min · Leave knowing what to change
